x: Halton, Geoff finished second to Briault in the Sefton Brancker Trophy match between the Civil Service, Middlesex and the R.A.F In leading the Civil Service team to victory Geoff easily beat Price, Pugh, Presland, Barratt, Cooper, Ellis, Entwistle, Mellor, Lindsell and Holts.

Manchester, with Entwistle had made a great effort to catch up and had reduced our lead to 40 seconds, though we were never in danger. After the race the boys (and the team manager) set out to enjoy themselves and were able to show the North brothers a thing or two about Blackpool which even they didn't know!
John regained a place and ran to form for a race of this length, but the five clubs ahead all moved away and Entwistle (Man DLC) and Hirons (Coventry) each gained over half a minute in our rear.
